scenes.title: Planetary Sky
scenes.viewerPurpose: Readers learn to ask what particles sunlight meets before reaching their eyes.
addOrChange: Planetary Sky connects the colors above us with light moving through an atmosphere.
Its journey extends from ordinary daylight to other planets, measurement, and cultural meaning.
Readers learn to ask what particles sunlight meets before reaching their eyes.

scenes.title: Particles change the picture
scenes.viewerPurpose: Measurement helps turn a changing visual impression into evidence that can be compared.
addOrChange: Molecules, droplets, dust, and pollution interact differently with light.
Other planetary atmospheres therefore invite comparison rather than an assumption of Earth’s blue.
